title: Output relations for identity relations (H5's rest): the same verdicts under JBMC and auto --confirm
description: A regression check's correspondence (step H5 of llm-dlc/loops/foundations-heap.md) may now give an output relation for an identity relation the check observes, identity:result==q, a boolean over whether it holds in each version (old.result == old.q, new.result == new.q), compared in the harness in place of 'holds before iff it holds now'. Over the joint example's two shapes of Quote (lib/tests/fixtures/foundations, with two more builds of withQuantity written by lib/tests/heap.rs), under old.result == old.q && new.result != new.q: a build that hands back a copy with the same values on purpose (copied) is verified; the build that hands back the quote itself (after) and one that does so only when the quantity is unchanged (sometimes-copied) are refuted in identity:result==q, their witnesses run on a JVM. Inline on the own checker all three pass. This job runs the ignored test that repeats the three under --engine jbmc and under --engine auto --confirm, where JBMC checks the same harness (the relation compiled over two booleans from if_acmp).
expected: exits 0: the ignored test passes. Under both engines: copied Verified, after and sometimes-copied Violation, each violation's witness run on a JVM (counterexample.jvm set).

resources.notes: a release build of the crate, then 6 small JBMC runs over reference comparisons
